unit.title: A Second Folk Tale: The Ant and the Grasshopper

contentBlocks.text: ਤੁਸੀਂ ਕਹਾਣੀ ਅਤੇ ਇਸ ਦਾ ਸਬਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ। ਅੱਜ ਰੁੱਤਾਂ ਬਾਰੇ ਲਿਖੋ! (You've learned the story and its lesson. Today, write about the seasons!)

This week's story used two seasons: warm months for playing/working, and ਸਰਦੀ (winter) when preparation mattered most. Write a short description of your own favorite season — describe what the weather is like, and one thing you like to do or ਤਿਆਰੀ (prepare) for during that season. Use at least 2 of this week's vocabulary words if they fit.
ਤੁਸੀਂ ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰਾ ਵੇਰਵਾ ਲਿਖਿਆ! (You just wrote a complete description!) Tomorrow we'll review everything from this week.

objectives: Write a short descriptive composition about a favorite season
Use at least 2 of this week's vocabulary words correctly in the composition
teacherGuide.facilitationScript:
1. Review this week's story and vocabulary.
2. Model a short example description of a season.
3. Have the child write their own description, checking for at least 2 vocabulary words.
4. Complete the worksheet.
5. Preview tomorrow's cumulative review.
differentiationTips: Struggling: provide a simple sentence-starter outline (What's the weather like → What do you do → What do you prepare for) to scaffold the description
Ready for more: ask the child to also describe how their chosen season connects to preparation, like the ant did
This lesson directly addresses the course's 'basic composition' goal, connecting this week's vocabulary/story content to real original writing
teacherGuide.answerKey: This is an open-ended writing activity — check that the child's description names a real season, describes it genuinely, and uses at least 2 of this week's vocabulary words correctly.
teacherGuide.standardsRationale: Directly addresses the course's 'basic composition' goal, synthesizing this week's vocabulary and story content into one real piece of original writing.

generationData.instructions: Describe your favorite season, using at least 2 of this week's vocabulary words.
